evidenceNote: Type25 date/steps example is from qualified P1-2B evidence; owner/device/session identifiers and Type24 values are synthetic fixtures, not a claim of another physical acquisition.

scenarios.name: qualified-type24-and-physical-type25-example
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 4 daily canonical rows and 10 minute rows; goal remains native-only.

scenarios.name: type24-same-day-correction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Same daily identity, updated value, 4 rows, both source ancestries retained.

scenarios.name: type24-historical-replay
scenarios.expectedBehavior: FINAL daily rows; replay adds no canonical rows.

scenarios.name: type25-exact-replay
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 10 minute rows; replay is DUPLICATE, no added epochs.

scenarios.name: type25-conflicting-replay
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Same vendor date with changed payload: both sources preserved, original 10 minutes retained, CONFLICT_PRESERVED.

scenarios.name: type25-invalid-array-length
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Integrity FAIL, ARRAY_LENGTH_NOT_10, raw record retained; no canonical minutes.

scenarios.name: type25-sum-mismatch
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Integrity FAIL, SUM_ARRAY_STEPS_NE_DETAIL_MINTER_STEP, raw record retained; no canonical minutes.

scenarios.name: type25-missing-segment
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 20 minute rows for two returned records; missing middle segment has no synthetic zeros.

scenarios.name: type25-never-replaces-type24-daily-authority
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Type25 supporting distance/calories and minute sums do not change any Type24 daily value.
